evals.name: vertical-reel-from-flow-clips
evals.prompt: I have five clips from Google Flow for our Roster launch (collab.fluodigital.com) in {inputs}/roster-clips. Make me a 30-second vertical reel for Instagram using only the render, brief and team clips (01, 02 and 05). Keep the clips' own sound, put motion graphics and subtitles on it based on the product, and end with collab.fluodigital.com. The page text is saved in {inputs}/roster-sources. Put the project in {outputs}.
evals.expected_output: A film-studio project with a film.json using clips 01, 02 and 05 in that order, 9:16 framing decisions per shot (blur fit or focus), graphics whose numbers all come from the page snapshots, a rendered 9:16 web MP4 of about 30 seconds with the clips' audio, an SRT file, a report with the claims table, and an end card showing collab.fluodigital.com.
assertions: film.json passes `studio.mjs check` with exit code 0
the shots use clips 01, 02 and 05 only, in that order
a 9:16 web MP4 exists at 1080×1920 and lasts 25–35 seconds
the MP4 has an audio stream and the spec keeps clip audio
every number on screen is found in the page snapshots and --allow-unsourced was not used
the end card URL contains collab.fluodigital.com
an SRT subtitle file exists with at least 3 cues
the two group shots (02 and 05) have an explicit 9:16 framing decision (fit or focus)

evals.name: plan-a-flow-shoot
evals.prompt: I want to make a 40-second launch film for collab.fluodigital.com (an AI creator marketplace called Roster) with Google Flow. I have Google AI Pro. Plan the shots and write the Flow prompts for me, and set up the project so that once I download the clips I can render it automatically. The page text is saved in {inputs}/roster-sources. Put the project in {outputs}.
evals.expected_output: A film-studio project with a film.json holding 5–8 shots, each with a Flow prompt, planned clip names, graphics and transitions totalling about 40 seconds, a generated prompts.md shot list, copy whose numbers all come from the page snapshots, and a reply that explains the hand-off: generate in Flow (no public API), download into clips/, then run check, stills and render.
assertions: film.json is valid JSON with 5–8 shots, each with a non-empty prompt
prompts.md exists with one section per shot
the planned film lasts 35–45 seconds (shot lengths minus transitions plus end card)
every number in the planned graphics is found in the page snapshots
no [placeholder] text is left in the spec
the reply says the clips are generated by hand in Flow and then rendered with the engine
